description: This file defines the SystemController class for an ASP.NET Core Web API, including endpoints for health checks, custom fields management, exportable items listing, and usage statistics. It also contains auxiliary classes for exportable items registry.

classes.name: ExportableItem
classes.description: Represents an exportable item with a key, description, and optional class type.

classes.name: ExportablesRegistry
classes.description: Static registry holding a list of exportable items with their keys and descriptions.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of custom fields, limited by a maximum value.

methods.name: Create (POST)
methods.description: Creates a new custom field entry in the database.

methods.name: Create (DELETE)
methods.description: Deletes a custom field by ID.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Performs health checks on directory write access, database connectivity, and Redis availability.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the list of exportable items with their keys and descriptions.

methods.name: CheckDirectoryWritable
methods.description: Checks if a directory is writable by attempting to write and delete a test file.

methods.name: CheckDatabaseAsync
methods.description: Verifies database connectivity by executing a simple SQL command.

methods.name: CheckRedisAsync
methods.description: Checks Redis server availability by pinging.

methods.name: GetUsage
methods.description: Retrieves usage data from the SystemUsageService.
